title: Mars transit

truth.label: Scripted illness (infection-like strain)
truth.detail: Scripted at 2.15 times the average real response: a peak resting heart rate rise of about 7 bpm. That is above the upper quartile of the real episodes (5.3 bpm) and matches the published median among cases a detector caught, so this is an easy case. The simulated rise starts up to 4 days before the symptom day. Real responses vary widely; in the simulator about three illnesses in ten have no heart-rate rise at all.

blurb: Four crew, 30 days of pre-flight baseline, then a 180-day outbound transit to Mars.
